description_te: ఆటో/టాక్సీ/మాక్సీ క్యాబ్ డ్రైవర్లకు ₹15,000 ఆర్థిక సహాయం. Insurance, fitness, permit ఖర్చులకు. DBT ద్వారా చెల్లించబడుతుంది.
description_en: ₹15,000 annual financial assistance to auto/taxi/maxi cab driver-cum-owners for insurance, fitness, and permit expenses.

eligibility_criteria.occupation: Must own and personally drive auto rickshaw, motor cab, or maxi cab
eligibility_criteria.vehicle: Vehicle must be operational for passenger transport, registered in AP with valid RC, tax, and fitness certificate
eligibility_criteria.license: Valid driving license issued in AP
eligibility_criteria.household_limit: Only one vehicle per household eligible

application_process_te:
1. NBM portal / GSWS portal ద్వారా apply చేయండి
2. WEA/DA login ద్వారా verification
3. Beneficiary list GSWS portal లో publish అవుతుంది
4. DBT ద్వారా bank account కి credit
go_reference: GO Ms. No. 25, dated 2019 (original); renamed and enhanced under TDP government
